question: What new facility was introduced by the Election Commission of India (ECI) at polling stations in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mobile phone deposit facility**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** introduced the **Mobile Phone Deposit Facility** at polling stations in **May 2025**. This initiative aims to ensure a smooth and distraction-free voting process.
 
• The facility is designed to provide a secure location for voters to deposit their mobile devices before entering the polling area, aligning with the guidelines prohibiting the use of mobile phones inside polling booths.
 
• This step was taken to ensure that voters can focus on exercising their voting rights without any external distractions or interruptions caused by mobile phones.
 
• By implementing this facility, the ECI aims to enhance the voting experience while ensuring the sanctity and confidentiality of the voting process.
 
• Additionally, it is a move to prevent potential misuse of mobile phones, such as capturing votes or violating the secrecy of the ballot.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**

 
 
• The **Election Commission of India** is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India at the national, state, and local levels.
 
• Established on **25 January 1950**, the ECI conducts free and fair elections in accordance with the Indian Constitution.
 
• It ensures the implementation of Model Code of Conduct and monitors fair voting practices to maintain the integrity of elections.
 
 
 
• **Mobile Phone Restrictions at Polling Stations:**
 
 
• Mobile phones are generally prohibited inside polling booths to maintain the **secrecy of the ballot** and to avoid distractions or disturbances.
 
• The **mobile phone deposit facility** provides a safe place for voters to temporarily keep their phones while casting their votes.
 
• This initiative addresses concerns regarding the misuse of mobile phones, such as capturing photos of ballots or influencing other voters.
 
 
 
• **Other Facilities at Polling Stations:**
 
 
• Polling stations often provide facilities such as **ramps for disabled voters**, drinking water, and basic amenities to ensure convenience.
 
• In recent years, the ECI has also focused on improving voter awareness and providing information through voter facilitation centers.
 
• Some states have introduced **queue management systems** and seating arrangements for senior citizens and differently-abled voters.
 
 
 
• **Role of Technology in Voting:**
 
 
• Technological advancements like **EVMs (Electronic Voting Machines)** and VVPAT (Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail) have been introduced to enhance transparency and reliability in the voting process.
 
• While online voting is not yet implemented in India, the ECI continues to explore technological solutions to make elections more accessible and efficient.
